ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced gravship weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct advanced gravship weaponry and targeting consoles, as well as gravship bombardment targeters.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravship defenses
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reinforce the gravship by constructing gravship armor and subarmor, as well as gravship shield generators, making it much more resistant to enemy fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced orbital tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct various buildings and apparel that improve the comfort and security of living in harsh vacuum of space.

ResearchProjectDef.label: warpods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop and construct various warpods for planetary bombardment, including high-explosive, EMP, incendiary and antigrain, as well as a way to rapidly deploy your boarding parties using hellpods.
